description: User-declared running HR bands, 2026-08-08. Personal calibration, not a device's bands and not 220-age (contract section 9). Zone 2 is 128-141 bpm and zone 5 opens at 172; the user declared no boundary between zones 3 and 4, so they are one honest aggregate band rather than an invented split. Resting floor was declared as 42-44 bpm; 43 is recorded as the midpoint. Applies to the run modality only (I9): no other modality may borrow these bands.

calibration.method: user-declared personal bands; heart-rate-reserve informed (max 182, resting floor 42-44)
